demand.execution_decomposition: Requested units are limited by stock, then cash; other validation failures are separate. Both stock and cash constraints may bind.
demand.interpretation: Desired/affordable units are a stock-independent scripted-policy counterfactual. Actual seller choice may differ; shadow fill ratios can exceed one. Measurement completeness and low rejection do not certify adequate household service.

production_and_inventory.depletion_note: Linear depletion diagnostics are not forecasts; a 120-tick pass does not establish long-run sustainability.
